title: Can Commercial LLMs Be Parliamentary Political Companions? Comparing LLM Reasoning Against Romanian Legislative Expuneri de Motive

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model-generated legislative rationales against official Romanian explanatory memoranda using LLM-as-Judge and programmatic text similarity metrics to determine whether errors stem from a stable ideological lean or task-dependent confabulation.

Comparing model reasoning performance across different task types (standardized EU directives versus politically idiosyncratic domestic Romanian proposals) to expose contextual ignorance driven by thin training data coverage for non-Anglophone legislative systems.
